notes: All sources are fixed official upstream artifact URLs and exact size/SHA-256 pins; no deployment license, model enablement or inference certification is granted by this inventory.
Source discovery downloaded only metadata/text/config files, never model weights. Previously verified model pins come from the preserved validation receipts and source recipes.

The inspected Seed-VC singing source commit 51383efd921027683c89e5348211d93ff12ac2a8 uses F0, BigVGAN 44k, Whisper small, CAMPPlus and RMVPE. Its config sets DiT.target=mel; the DAC configuration stanza does not activate a separate pretrained codec checkpoint. No irrelevant codec weights are declared mandatory.
Other Seed configurations can select different vocoders/semantic encoders. Their concrete managed manifest must declare those files; this list does not authorize substitutes.
The original YourMT3 .ckpt files require the existing strict tensor-only conversion recipe. Downloading/staging an original checkpoint does not make it an admitted safetensors runtime.
Transkun wheel is preserved as a complete pinned artifact. Its download is not asserted to install an environment or execute its pretrained model.

The original complete Qixuan bank and OpenVPI vocoder release packages are pinned by GitHub API asset metadata (name, size, browser_download_url and SHA-256 digest). Downloads preserve the entire upstream package; staging does not activate a voicebank or grant redistribution/commercial rights.
